ratings.reason: FluidToken offloads bounded prefill compute to decode workers and FluidRole reassigns running workers between prefill/decode roles in place via lightweight pressure indices, lifting SLO attainment up to 94.6 points over static SGLang — LLM serving cluster resource management without extra GPUs.

AttSVD's per-prompt attention-guided truncated SVD truncates only in the subspaces attention actually reads to preserve attention logits and outputs, a fidelity-first KV-cache compression design at 50% memory — precision preservation under aggressive inference optimization rather than a pure memory win.

Applies Transcoders to CLIP/DINO encoders to recover semantically labeled features and traces metonymic circuits where concrete anchor concepts causally mediate abstract concept grounding, validated by causal interventions.

Condition-anchored generative distillation with an exact chain-rule decomposition of teacher-rollout sequence divergence stabilizes continual adaptation (four-task held-out loss 2.927 to 1.114) — model-level training stability, though distinct from the area's large-scale run monitoring focus.

Shows text-to-image activation trajectories for intermediate concepts substantially deviate from the linear direction connecting endpoints, challenging the Linear Representation Hypothesis, and fits Kolmogorov-Arnold-network steering curves (KANSteer) as an interpretable non-linear alternative.

FactorBench is an automated-benchmark contract scoring ~5000 factors from nine automated mining paradigms including LLM agents across five equity markets, tracing factor validity, temporal generalization, and after-cost portfolio performance — benchmark infrastructure for automated discovery systems.

Trains low-rank activation-steering decision operators by behavior cloning (23K-330K params) and uses a logit-lens probe plus gradient-flow analysis to show the operator amplifies answers along the model's existing late-layer pathway rather than writing them earlier.

SAGA is a self-evolving agent framework that progressively abstracts interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, closing an execution-abstraction feedback loop that continuously updates hierarchical memory.

APEX directly targets trustworthiness of autonomous LLM agents: a pre-compiled authorization contract enforces evidence-gated prevention and deception-based exposure at the execution boundary, achieving 0% attack success on five of six indirect-prompt-injection benchmarks and 0% under adaptive attacks.

AegisFlow's Watchdog/Repair agent pair performs autonomous remediation via Parallel Shadow Patching in a MAPE-K digital-twin loop, generating, testing, and deploying LLM-written code patches that cut MTTR from 170 minutes to 3.2 minutes.

Reframes frozen atomistic foundation models as fast decision-makers emitting calibrated probabilities with finite-sample guarantees and value-of-information gating for materials-discovery triage, validated prospectively against 700 new DFT calculations — automated scientific discovery support, though without an evolving agent loop.

EPOCH is an evidence-governed autonomous research loop — explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay — that makes AI research agents' discoveries trustworthy, achieving SOTA on AlgoTune (0.65 vs 0.53 mean normalized score).

TopoPlanner lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and applies cosheaf-consistent retrieval so LLM planners handle verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states in tool orchestration.

Core to the SDC program: a fault injection framework maps CNN parameters onto ReRAM crossbars and quantifies how stuck-at-high/stuck-at-low hardware faults degrade classification accuracy by layer, location, and fault type in process-in-memory accelerators.

JoyAI-Voice 2.0 is a corporate speech-generation technical report (semantic-acoustic dual encoder, flow matching, DiffusionNFT RL), but it comes from outside the major AI labs the area targets and includes no system card or safety evaluation.
